scan.title: Find SmartDot
scan.description: Close Petoneer on your phone. Make sure your Bluetooth adapter or active Bluetooth proxy can see the device, then retry.

device.title: Choose SmartDot
device.description: Original SmartDot devices use PetCat. V2 devices advertise Tuya FD50, often as TY. V2 account credentials will be checked against the selected Bluetooth device.

manual.title: Device and generation
manual.description: Enter the complete Bluetooth address. On macOS, use the full CoreBluetooth UUID.

account.title: Get SmartDot V2 keys
account.description: Enter your Petoneer account email and password. The password is used only during setup and is not saved. The cloud is used to retrieve keys; everyday control uses local Bluetooth.

cloud_device.title: Choose your SmartDot V2
cloud_device.description: All devices from your Petoneer account are listed. Choose the SmartDot V2 matching the Bluetooth device selected earlier. Close Petoneer on your phone: the integration will validate its keys over Bluetooth without starting a game.

error.invalid_address: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address or complete CoreBluetooth UUID.
error.no_devices_found: No candidate devices are visible. Close the phone app, check active Bluetooth connections, then retry.
error.invalid_region: Choose a supported cloud region or Automatic.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Petoneer/Tuya API. Check network connectivity or try the account cloud region.
error.invalid_auth: The email/password or account region was rejected. Check your login details and cloud region before retrying.
error.captcha_required: Petoneer requires a captcha. Complete verification in the official app, then try again.
error.mfa_required: Petoneer requires an additional verification step. Complete it in the official app, then try again.
error.account_locked: The account is temporarily locked. Stop retrying and check the official app.
error.profile_expired: The server rejected this version of the Petoneer application profile. Update the integration.
error.cloud_error: The Petoneer API returned an unsupported response. No password or session was saved.
error.no_cloud_devices: No devices were found in this account/region.
error.device_not_found: This device was not returned by the authenticated account.
error.missing_keys: The API did not return the required identifiers and local key for this device.
error.cannot_connect_ble: Cannot authenticate the selected Bluetooth device. Close the phone app, verify the chosen device, and check active Bluetooth/proxy access. No game was started.
error.unsupported_api: This mobile API operation is not supported.

abort.already_configured: This Bluetooth device is already configured.
abort.not_supported: This advertisement is not a supported SmartDot candidate.
